mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are called electrons and positive charges are called protons."
Negative charges are called electrons and positive charges are called protons.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is called the momentum and r is the distance of the electron from the nucleus (or radius of the allowed orbit)."
The quantity mv is called the momentum and r is the distance of the electron from the nucleus (or radius of the allowed orbit).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is made up of protons and neutrons."
The nucleus is made up of protons and neutrons.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a way the scientist gives its own picture of how an atom looks like."
An atomic model is a way the scientist gives its own picture of how an atom looks like.
fib: ______ is called the moment of momentum.
The product mv X r is called the moment of momentum.
